title: "Data Summary"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
setup_file <- if (file.exists("_report_setup.R")) "_report_setup.R" else file.path("report", "code", "_report_setup.R")
source(setup_file)
sample_alignment <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "sample_alignment.tsv"))
sample_summary <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "sample_summary.tsv"))
feature_summary <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "feature_summary.tsv"))
feature_map <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "feature_map.tsv"))
preprocessing_summary <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "preprocessing_summary.tsv"))
```

## Preprocessing Summary

```{r}
table_out(preprocessing_summary, "Preprocessing summary")
```

## Sample Alignment

```{r}
table_out(sample_alignment, "Metadata and feature-table alignment", n = 100)
```

## Sample Counts

```{r}
table_out(sample_summary, "Sample counts")
```
